name: Galathea National Park
description: Located on the southeastern coast of Great Nicobar Island, Galathea National Park is one of the most pristine and biodiverse protected areas of the Andaman & Nicobar Islands. name: Barren Island
description: Situated in the Andaman Sea, Barren Island is approximately 138 kilometres northeast of Sri Vijaya Puram, the capital city of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. It is renowned for being South Asia's only active volcano, which last erupted in 2017. The island spans about 3 square kilometres and is predominantly covered by volcanic cones and ash, with little vegetation visible from afar.
